in_marathi.name: Anuraag
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anuraag हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anuraag is derived from the Sanskrit root 'anu' meaning towards and 'raga' meaning passion, desire or emotion. The name signifies the deep love, affection and passion one feels towards someone or something.
